records.name: Android Rush
records.character_source: Android 16 / Android 16 customizable partner / Android 17 (DB Super) customizable partner / Gamma 1
records.skill_description: A close-range rush of three kicks followed by a backhand that knocks the opponent away.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 skill reference describes three kicks followed by a backhand. Directional control changes the direction in which the opponent is launched: neutral sends them forward, up sends them downward, and down sends them upward. The move is close-range and consists of four damaging hits before knockback.
records.acquisition_notes: The canonical Future Warrior acquisition route is Android 16 mentor training. Character customization availability is retained as metadata rather than treated as a separate acquisition route.
records.pve_notes: Mentor-training acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Close-range Strike Super with directional knockback control. Exact frame and matchup behavior remains version-sensitive.
